name: atlanai
description: Your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, from the Atlan registry. One sign-in, no API key.

interface.longDescription: Connect your coding agent to the Atlan registry with one OAuth sign-in. Search your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, install a registry skill into the current project, reach every MCP server your organization registered through one gateway, and publish skills, agents and outputs back with the registry's own authoring recipes.
